accepted.quote: This Resolution of Inquiry (ROI) is an important step in ensuring Congress continues its important job of oversight over the Executive Branch.
accepted.rationale: Neal endorses the ROI as necessary congressional oversight of executive access to Treasury systems.

accepted.quote: Mr. Musk and members of DOGE are ignoring two federal privacy laws: (1) Section 6103 of the Internal Revenue Code and (2) the Privacy Act of 1974.
accepted.rationale: Neal criticizes DOGE for violating Section 6103 confidentiality protections for taxpayer information.

accepted.quote: No one should be rummaging around in the confidential information of private citizens at any agency where protected information resides.
accepted.rationale: Neal opposes unauthorized access to confidential government-held personal information across agencies.
